chapter: Playing in clubs and Mardi Gras
title: Abbie at the Hotsi Totsi, pedal-note trombone and prohibition clubs
summary: Brunies recalls Abbie's horn tricks at a speakeasy, his own trick of playing trombone on cornet with pedal notes, and clubs along Dauphine Street in prohibition.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: I don't know if Abby ever told you about... How you used to jam the silk paintings up in there. No, I don't believe so. They had a place on Common Street, right off the dryings. In the speaking easy days. Called a Hotsi Totsi. And the racehorse men used to go up in there. And Abby, Jan, that silk paintings. Who was one of the grandpas's henkerchiefs. And the bell of the horn. And it would sound like it was maybe ten miles away. You know, it was... It would be pretty. And they threw a hundred dollar bills in the kid. Fifty dollar bills. Take the kid and bust it up that night. Nose lock it. I'll turn on... This is Richie talking.

This ain't Henny Bernis, you know. His wife. Another thing, I could take a cornet and turn it into a slide trombone. Imitate it. You didn't? Yeah. But did you slide the... No, I just play all the pedal notes and change my slides. Oh.
I thought maybe you'd slide the tuning slide.
Pedal note tone. Yeah. You see? Like a transfer of notes or anything.
Way down a lot of people.

And they all used to come in the place and say, Where's the trombone play at? I said, I did. Trombone. They used. He plays trumpet. I don't believe it. I said, all right, let's go band. Man, you play better trombone play. Pedal notes and all like that. Yeah. Yeah. We used to do good there. We used to do good. We used to do shamrock in them places. You know, doing prohibition.
Where were they located those clubs?
D'Angelo Street. All along D'Angelo Street. Johnny's Place and the shamrock and the sweet potato ring. You go in there already, but I don't know how you're going to come out.
I played there before. Did you play the Cadillac? It was on. I played St. Louis on. I got a ramp.
